references.text: Warning that the peoples who are not driven out will become a trap and a trouble, a similar theme about the dangers of leaving the nations in the land
Warning that worshiping their gods will become a trap, using the same expression 'ki-moqesh hu lakh' (for it will be a trap for you)
Prohibition against making a covenant with the inhabitants of the land and warning that their gods will become a trap
Warning against following after the nations' gods and their worship practices after they have been destroyed
Detailed command to destroy idols and not bring them into the house, since they are devoted to destruction
Command not to show pity, using the same expression 'lo tachos einekha' (your eye shall not show mercy)
The same command not to show pity in the context of idol worship
Joshua's warning that the remaining peoples will become traps and snares if Israel mixes with them
Fulfillment of the warning: those who remained in the land became snares for Israel
